newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Yankee bond issue split into two tranches.
newsitem.headline: Polish Yankee bond issue split into two tranches.

text.p: Poland decided to split its Yankee bond issue, expected later this week, into a seven-year tranche and most probably a 20-year tranche, Finance Minister Marek Belka said on Wednesday.
"We decided to divide the new (Yankee bond) issue into seven-year bonds and most probably 20-year bonds. The final decision should be made within hours," Belka told a news conference.
"Investors like the long-term perspectives of Poland's economy," he added, commenting on the reason for the issue split.

He expected the issue to amount to about $300 million and he said that even though this year's budget limit for foreign issues was $500 million, the government was not planning further issues in 1997.
He declined to give the breakdown of the seven and 20-year tranches or the expected spread on the bonds.
